art_instructions: Set a cozy dining room under soft warm lamplight. Center a round oak table in the lower half of the image, with a sage-green placemat and a small cream ceramic cup (blue rim) of clear water in front of the Owl. The Owl (mottled brown-and-cream feathers, round amber eyes, small green scarf) sits on a mismatched wooden chair on the near side of the table, slightly right of center; her tiny satchel hangs from the chair back. She holds the cup with both wings and tips it gently so her beak touches the water; show a subtle ripple on the surface and a small droplet at her beak to make “drinking” obvious. On the table to her left, place a short clay pitcher half-full of water with a faint sheen to reinforce that it’s water. In the background, include a cream wall with a rounded archway on the left leading to another room, a wooden sideboard beneath a glowing cloth-shaded lamp, and a window with muted sage-green curtains on the right; hint at wooden ceiling beams above. The Owl looks content and focused, eyes soft, seated at child eye level, and occupies about 40% of the frame height.
